肉体成圣的好处（肉体成圣的好处（第22页）“能够得到雷帝老人家青睐的人绝对不会是什么简单的人，甚至来说，如果让眼前的这些人都不一定能够比得上他，可能都要比他弱上几分的，单纯第一关就已经足够让我们相当吃惊的，我们掌管这个黄泉阴阳眼争夺那么多年了，试问一句，有没有人能够超过他的呢？”九幽璃听到这一番话时，不由得微微摇摇头道：“先不说其他的，就算是我与你在同等级时，都不可能做到的，假以时日，他必定会成就一番霸业！绝对不会你我之下的，他能够肉体成圣就是算得上他一个大坎啦！可能他将会成为黄金瞳的最佳人选，我们也是时候做点准备啦！万一他真的是我们等待的人，我也不至于一点准备都没有啦！”苍龙听到九幽璃的话时，这一点也是算得上足够让他自身稳定下来了，毕竟这个东西就是他为何愿意亲自去接冯斗来的主要原因，其实很多时候，他曾经多次感受到整个黄泉路出现空间破裂的情况，他每次都尽力地弥补这个缺口，可是事实上，他都感受到整个黄泉路渐渐地超出他的意料啦！所以他才觉得冯斗的出现可能就是冥冥之中注定的，然而冯斗的实力实在太弱了，他又担心冯斗会因此而夭折了，这样就有点得不偿失了，正是如此，他就更加是让冯斗活下去，因为他自己都明白的，他绝对不可能一直这样无条件地维护下去的，时间一长必然是漏洞百出的，渐渐地整个黄泉路到底会发展成怎么样，他自己都不敢肯定，毕竟这里的未知实在太多了。事实证明了一点，那就是他这次真的做对了，甚至来说，他看到自己多年的坚持终于看到了希望啦！另外一方面，冯斗通过了第一关时，他感受到前所未有的痛快，他也是第一次使用肉体来证实一切，不过他能够清晰地感受到了自己的肉体居然能够强大到这个地步。他也是第一次感受到了肉体成圣的红利，哪怕是他都不敢相信这一点，毕竟肉体成圣这一点算得上他的强处啦！可是他不急着要进入第二个考验，毕竟他现在如果继续进行下去，不如是给那些人趟雷，毕竟这里的四十九个人，只有不到五个人曾经参加过黄泉阴阳眼的争夺，然而还有两个人连第一个考验都没有经过的。可是另外三个人也不过经历不到第三关考验了，这一点也是足够让冯斗不会主动地考虑那么多了，毕竟肯定有不少人会愿意做这个出头鸟的，至于到底会怎么样就不知道了，他也不想去考虑那么多的。其实冯斗是借机偷闲而已！毕竟有些东西不需要他来亲自冒险的，他又何必做这些呢？就在此时，又有两个人出现了，他们出现了之后，他们第一时间就已经是将目光投向了冯斗，然而冯斗并太在乎那么多的，毕竟他们在冯斗的眼中算得上真正的对手啦！其中一个人说：“就算那么快完成了第一关的考验又如何呢？不是一样都在这里静静看着吗？”然而另外一个人则说：“兄台，你不要怪他，他叫老邱，名邱立秋，属于散修，同时就是属于圣神境三段的实力，他当年参加过黄泉阴阳眼夺得，进而到达了第三关的考验，结果让人偷袭反而落得失败啦！”冯斗并没有想到对方居然会有了这样直白的，他不由得笑道：“不知道兄弟的名号如何呢？”那个人不由得行礼道：“小人名叫莫贵！”

The Benefits of Physical Sanctification (Benefits of Physical Sanctification (Page 22)) "The person who can be favored by the Thunder Emperor will definitely not be a simple person. In fact, if these people in front of you are not necessarily comparable to him, they may be a few points weaker than him. The first level alone is enough to surprise us. We have been in charge of this underworld Yin and Yang eye competition for so many years. I want to ask, is there anyone who can surpass him?" When Jiu Youli heard these words, she couldn't help but De shook his head slightly and said: "Let's not talk about other things. Even if you and I were at the same level, it would be impossible for him to do it. Given time, he will definitely achieve some hegemony! He will definitely not be inferior to you and me. If he can become a saint in body, he can be regarded as one. It's a big hurdle! Maybe he will be the best candidate for Golden Eyes. It's time for us to make some preparations! If he is really the one we are waiting for, I won't be unprepared at all!" When Canglong heard Jiu Youli's words, this was also considered. It was enough to stabilize himself. After all, this thing was the main reason why he was willing to pick up Feng Dou in person. In fact, many times, he had felt the space rupture in the entire Huangquan Road. He tried his best to make up for this gap every time, but in fact, he felt that the entire Huangquan Road was gradually beyond his expectation, so he felt that Feng Dou's appearance might be destined. However, Feng Dou's strength was too weak, and he was worried about Feng Dou! He would die prematurely because of this, which would be a bit of a loss. Because of this, he wanted Feng Dou to live even more, because he knew that he would never be able to maintain it unconditionally. Over time, it would be full of loopholes. Gradually, he was not sure how the entire Huangquan Road would develop. After all, there were too many unknowns here. The facts proved that he really did the right thing this time. In fact, he saw that he had persevered for many years. Finally saw hope! On the other hand, when Feng Dou passed the first level, he felt unprecedented pleasure. It was the first time that he used his body to confirm everything, but he could clearly feel that his body could be so powerful. It was also the first time that he felt the benefits of physical sanctification. Even he couldn't believe it. After all, physical sanctification was his strength, but he was not in a hurry to enter the second test. After all, if he now If we continue, we might as well give those people a chance. After all, of the forty-nine people here, less than five have participated in the battle for the Underworld Yin and Yang Eyes. However, there are still two people who have not even passed the first test. However, the other three people have not been able to pass the third test. This is enough for Feng Dou not to take the initiative to think so much. After all, there must be many people who are willing to be the first person. As for what will happen, he doesn’t know, and he doesn’t want to think about it. In fact, Feng Dou just took the opportunity to take risks! After all, there were some things that he didn't need to take risks himself. At this moment, two more people appeared. After they appeared, they immediately set their sights on Feng Dou. However, Feng Dou didn't care too much. After all, they were considered real opponents in Feng Dou's eyes! One of them said, "So what if they completed the first test so quickly? They are not just here to watch. "But another person said: "Brother, don't blame him. His name is Lao Qiu, his name is Qiu Liqiu, he is a casual cultivator, and he has the strength of the third level of the Holy God Realm. He participated in the Huangquan Yin and Yang Eyes and reached the third level of the test. It turned out that the sneak attack failed!" Feng Dou didn't expect that the other party would be so straightforward. He couldn't help but laugh: "I wonder what my brother's name is?" The man couldn't help but saluted: "The villain's name is Mo Gui!"
